notes: [S004.N1] The typescript is manuscript page 3, with a separate lower-left archive 3 recorded only in a comment. Its sole opening display completes the preceding page’s cohomology discussion. The headings are Cas particuliers and 2. Catégories de Picard. No date or total page count appears, and the sheet ends mid-sentence after catégories de. Interlinear doit, développer and géométrique are typed; Deligne and the insertion hooks are pen additions by an unnamed hand.

[S004.N2] The page states classification up to tensor equivalence by a group pi_0, a commutative group pi_1 with action and an arbitrary H^3 class, with a Baer-style interpretation of the group law. Its examples are qualified in its own words: on doit retrouver bien sûr the Postnikoff invariant; k(C) semble nouveau; and Il resterait à développer un lien géométrique direct with Mac-Lane’s extension/kernel theory. These are reported assertions and open tasks, not results proved in this run. The source spellings Postnikoff, groupoide, biModules, un Anneau and cancelled élement are preserved.

[S004.N3] Section 2 defines a Picard category by ACU structure with an underlying (Gr)-category, and strictness by identity symmetry on X tensor X. It warns that a (Gr)-equivalence need not respect the commutativity constraints. The final action target is visibly looped and retained as pi_{0|1}, even though the construction on scan 003 concerns pi_1. A limited calculation explains that expected target: for u in Aut(1), set A(u)=l_X(u tensor id_X)l_X^{-1} and B(u)=r_X(id_X tensor u)r_X^{-1}. Naturality of the symmetry c_{1,X} gives c_{1,X}(u tensor id_X)=(id_X tensor u)c_{1,X}; its unit compatibility r_X c_{1,X}=l_X yields A(u)=B(u). Thus their induced action on Aut(1)=pi_1 is trivial. This uses the standard unit compatibility of the ACU structure and does not resolve the ink or prove the classification.

[S004.N4] The main crops resolve let, établir, développées ici, et, the old E beneath G, the cancelled (Gr), and the opening parenthesis at the split géo-/métrique. The insertion géométrique belongs before the live underlined direct. The opening display’s second group glyph remains K|pi, with K first from the strokes. Other unresolved underletters and the final subscript are listed explicitly; seven loci remain uncertain.

[S004.N5] All three complete readings were compared, and the main reader inspected 19 reused reader crops plus 11 additional tight crops. Two initial main crops clipped the comma or the upper part of cancelled catég; adjusted crops were made only while those loci remained unsettled. All derived images are retained. H’s editorial uncertainty about établir and géométrique/direct was credited, while its descriptions were not used to settle the source.
